title: Transition of the evaluated root line on tensor generators
statement: Fix l,E,T and Chern data c [def-sp-tower-class-chern]. For n<=m, a chart U and an actual root z at level m, the actual lineModule transition sends lineEvaluation(m).inv(tateFiniteTensor(1,z)) to a section HEq to lineEvaluation(n).inv(tateFiniteTensor(1, roots.map(n<=m)(z))). HEq retains the unchanged section carrier under coefficient restriction while distinguishing the module scalar structures. No base change morphism or geometric inverse image occurs.

source.place: clause (2), scalar extension of the roots tower; horizontal transition calculation of lem-sfb-tower-class-line-pullback-existence

proof.text: Lift z through rootForget and the Forget section equality. The lineEvaluation normalization identifies the inverse image of a unit tensor z with the scalar-adjunction unit of that lifted root.

Normalize the scalar-adjunction unit at coefficient one. Naturality of that unit along the horizontal product-site arrow commutes it with the root-module restriction. This proves the unit-tensor formula directly; scalar-action comparisons are unnecessary.

The transitions equation of Forget and naturality of rootForget identify the restricted root with the actual roots-tower transition. Apply the lineEvaluation normalization at n and cancel the evaluation isomorphism to identify the normalized inverse tensor generator. These section calculations include empty charts and m=n.

proof_origin.place: classes (2), scalar extension and horizontal naturality of the roots tower

theorem lineEvaluation_transition_tensor {T : Scheme.{u}} (c : Chern l E T)
    {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (z : (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnitySheaf T (l ^ (m + 1))).obj.obj U) :
    HEq
      (((SemilinearSections.transition.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (SpTowerShriek.B l E T)
        (SpTowerShriek.tau l E T) h).app (lineModule l E c)).val.app U
          ((lineEvaluation l E c m).inv.val.app U
            (Scheme.tateFiniteTensor T l (FiniteRing l E m) m (finiteScalar l E m)
              U.unop 1 z)))
      ((lineEvaluation l E c n).inv.val.app U
        (Scheme.tateFiniteTensor T l (FiniteRing l E n) n (finiteScalar l E n)
          U.unop 1 (((roots l T).map (homOfLE h).op).hom.app U z)))
